title: Combine newsprint identity with mobile app navigation
description: Keep newsprint styling. Add viewport app shell, persistent mobile navigation, accessible sheets and independent workspace scrolling. Verify existing local synthetic workflows.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reviewable checkpoint: viewport shell and mobile navigation/sheet browser check pass. Actual original CMS workspace/article components imported unchanged into synthetic demo routes; policies, sections, users/merge controls and topic proposals rendered. Build, isolated TypeScript/ESLint and 8 gateway/catalog tests pass. Full CMS workflow QA and production backend mapping remain pending; original demo state resets on reload. Ryan requires preserving taxonomy, concepts, knowledge, merges, curation, policies and other original CMS capabilities; no claim of completed parity.
